cases.system_answer:
The repeated BinderException indicates the column name in HP_FLD_002 is **`nri_riverine_flood`** (without `_score`), not `nri_riverine_flood_score`. Final corrected query:

```sql
WITH shelters AS (
  SELECT s.hex_id
  FROM HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N s
  JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x ON s.hex_id = x.hex_id
  WHERE x.County = 'Galveston County' AND s.shelter_count > 0
),
filtered_flood AS (
  SELECT hp.hex_id
  FROM HP_FLD_002 hp
  JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x ON hp.hex_id = x.hex_id
  WHERE x.County = 'Galveston County' AND hp.nri_riverine_flood < 75
),
accessible_roads AS (
  SELECT t.hex_id
  FROM TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX t
  JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x ON t.hex_id = x.hex_id
  WHERE x.County = 'Galveston County'
  AND t.road_crit_index > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(road_crit_index, 0.2) FROM TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX)
),
viable_shelters AS (
  SELECT s.hex_id
  FROM shelters s
  INTERSECT
  SELECT f.hex_id FROM filtered_flood f
  INTERSECT
  SELECT r.hex_id FROM accessible_roads r
),
demand_estimate AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(population_7km) * 0.10) AS demand
  FROM EX_POP_001 e
  JOIN hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk x ON e.hex_id = x.hex_id
  WHERE x.County = 'Galveston County'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT demand FROM demand_estimate) - (SELECT COUNT(*) * 200 FROM viable_shelters) AS shelter_gap,
  'IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED' AS criticality_flag;
```
